# Province scope. Appraisers: appraiser_2, appraiser_3, appraiser_4.
DA_MEC_sync_appraiser = {
	if = {
		limit = { OR = { has_building = DA_arcane_appraiser has_building = DA_arcane_tech_exchange } }
		if = { limit = { owner = { has_country_flag = DA_mechanics_upgrade.appraiser_4.flag } NOT = { has_province_modifier = DA_mechanics_upgrade.appraiser_4 } } remove_province_modifier = DA_mechanics_upgrade.appraiser_2 remove_province_modifier = DA_mechanics_upgrade.appraiser_3 add_permanent_province_modifier = { name = DA_mechanics_upgrade.appraiser_4 duration = -1 } }
		if = { limit = { owner = { has_country_flag = DA_mechanics_upgrade.appraiser_3.flag NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_mechanics_upgrade.appraiser_4.flag } } NOT = { has_province_modifier = DA_mechanics_upgrade.appraiser_3 } } remove_province_modifier = DA_mechanics_upgrade.appraiser_2 remove_province_modifier = DA_mechanics_upgrade.appraiser_4 add_permanent_province_modifier = { name = DA_mechanics_upgrade.appraiser_3 duration = -1 } }
		if = { limit = { owner = { has_country_flag = DA_mechanics_upgrade.appraiser_2.flag NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_mechanics_upgrade.appraiser_3.flag } } NOT = { has_province_modifier = DA_mechanics_upgrade.appraiser_2 } } remove_province_modifier = DA_mechanics_upgrade.appraiser_3 remove_province_modifier = DA_mechanics_upgrade.appraiser_4 add_permanent_province_modifier = { name = DA_mechanics_upgrade.appraiser_2 duration = -1 } }
		if = { limit = { owner = { NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_mechanics_upgrade.appraiser_2.flag } } OR = { has_province_modifier = DA_mechanics_upgrade.appraiser_2 has_province_modifier = DA_mechanics_upgrade.appraiser_3 has_province_modifier = DA_mechanics_upgrade.appraiser_4 } } remove_province_modifier = DA_mechanics_upgrade.appraiser_2 remove_province_modifier = DA_mechanics_upgrade.appraiser_3 remove_province_modifier = DA_mechanics_upgrade.appraiser_4 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { OR = { has_building = DA_arcane_appraiser has_building = DA_arcane_tech_exchange } } OR = { has_province_modifier = DA_mechanics_upgrade.appraiser_2 has_province_modifier = DA_mechanics_upgrade.appraiser_3 has_province_modifier = DA_mechanics_upgrade.appraiser_4 } }
		remove_province_modifier = DA_mechanics_upgrade.appraiser_2 remove_province_modifier = DA_mechanics_upgrade.appraiser_3 remove_province_modifier = DA_mechanics_upgrade.appraiser_4
	}
}
# Province scope. Great Artisans: artisan_2, artisan_3, artisan_4.
DA_MEC_sync_artisan = {
	if = {
		limit = { OR = { has_building = DA_artisan_building_1 has_building = DA_artisan_building_2 has_building = DA_artisan_building_3 } }
		if = { limit = { owner = { has_country_flag = DA_mechanics_upgrade.artisan_4.flag } NOT = { has_province_modifier = DA_mechanics_upgrade.artisan_4 } } remove_province_modifier = DA_mechanics_upgrade.artisan_2 remove_province_modifier = DA_mechanics_upgrade.artisan_3 add_permanent_province_modifier = { name = DA_mechanics_upgrade.artisan_4 duration = -1 } }
		if = { limit = { owner = { has_country_flag = DA_mechanics_upgrade.artisan_3.flag NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_mechanics_upgrade.artisan_4.flag } } NOT = { has_province_modifier = DA_mechanics_upgrade.artisan_3 } } remove_province_modifier = DA_mechanics_upgrade.artisan_2 remove_province_modifier = DA_mechanics_upgrade.artisan_4 add_permanent_province_modifier = { name = DA_mechanics_upgrade.artisan_3 duration = -1 } }
		if = { limit = { owner = { has_country_flag = DA_mechanics_upgrade.artisan_2.flag NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_mechanics_upgrade.artisan_3.flag } } NOT = { has_province_modifier = DA_mechanics_upgrade.artisan_2 } } remove_province_modifier = DA_mechanics_upgrade.artisan_3 remove_province_modifier = DA_mechanics_upgrade.artisan_4 add_permanent_province_modifier = { name = DA_mechanics_upgrade.artisan_2 duration = -1 } }
		if = { limit = { owner = { NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_mechanics_upgrade.artisan_2.flag } } OR = { has_province_modifier = DA_mechanics_upgrade.artisan_2 has_province_modifier = DA_mechanics_upgrade.artisan_3 has_province_modifier = DA_mechanics_upgrade.artisan_4 } } remove_province_modifier = DA_mechanics_upgrade.artisan_2 remove_province_modifier = DA_mechanics_upgrade.artisan_3 remove_province_modifier = DA_mechanics_upgrade.artisan_4 }
	}
	if = {

# Province scope. Every line, the old tiers of the five lines that grow with them; the retired lines off (doc 85).
DA_MEC_province_sync = {
	DA_MEC_sync_appraiser = yes
	DA_MEC_sync_artisan = yes
	DA_MEC_sync_assembler = yes
	DA_MEC_sync_counting = yes
	DA_MEC_sync_tithes = yes
	DA_MEC_sync_excise = yes
	DA_MEC_sync_wardens = yes
	DA_MEC_sync_keepers = yes
	DA_MEC_sync_valve = yes
	DA_MEC_sync_cables = yes
	DA_MEC_sync_mines = yes
	DA_MEC_sync_fortif = yes
	DA_MEC_sync_arsenals = yes
	DA_MEC_sync_coastal = yes
	DA_MEC_sync_wharves = yes
	DA_MEC_sync_lights = yes
	DA_MEC_sync_foundry = yes
	DA_MEC_sync_mentors = yes
	DA_MEC_sync_machines = yes
	DA_MEC_sync_labs = yes
	DA_MEC_sync_healing = yes
	DA_MEC_retired = yes
}

# Province scope (doc 85). The retired lines (Missions, Drydocks): their modifiers off.
DA_MEC_retired = {
	if = {
		limit = { OR = { has_province_modifier = DA_mechanics_upgrade.missions_1 has_province_modifier = DA_mechanics_upgrade.missions_2 has_province_modifier = DA_mechanics_upgrade.missions_3 has_province_modifier = DA_mechanics_upgrade.missions_4 has_province_modifier = DA_mechanics_upgrade.drydocks_1 has_province_modifier = DA_mechanics_upgrade.drydocks_2 has_province_modifier = DA_mechanics_upgrade.drydocks_3 has_province_modifier = DA_mechanics_upgrade.drydocks_4 } }
		remove_province_modifier = DA_mechanics_upgrade.missions_1
		remove_province_modifier = DA_mechanics_upgrade.missions_2
		remove_province_modifier = DA_mechanics_upgrade.missions_3
		remove_province_modifier = DA_mechanics_upgrade.missions_4
		remove_province_modifier = DA_mechanics_upgrade.drydocks_1
		remove_province_modifier = DA_mechanics_upgrade.drydocks_2
		remove_province_modifier = DA_mechanics_upgrade.drydocks_3
		remove_province_modifier = DA_mechanics_upgrade.drydocks_4
	}
}

# Country scope (doc 85), from DA_MEC_monthly: a realm that bought a retired upgrade gets its points back (tier N, N
# points); the flags go and the owned provinces are cleaned.
DA_MEC_retire = {
	if = {
		limit = { OR = { has_country_flag = DA_mechanics_upgrade.missions_1.flag has_country_flag = DA_mechanics_upgrade.missions_2.flag has_country_flag = DA_mechanics_upgrade.missions_3.flag has_country_flag = DA_mechanics_upgrade.missions_4.flag has_country_flag = DA_mechanics_upgrade.drydocks_1.flag has_country_flag = DA_mechanics_upgrade.drydocks_2.flag has_country_flag = DA_mechanics_upgrade.drydocks_3.flag has_country_flag = DA_mechanics_upgrade.drydocks_4.flag } }
		every_owned_province = { DA_MEC_retired = yes }
		if = { limit = { has_country_flag = DA_mechanics_upgrade.missions_1.flag } clr_country_flag = DA_mechanics_upgrade.missions_1.flag hidden_effect = { change_variable = { which = DA_mechanics_inno_points value = 1 } } }
		if = { limit = { has_country_flag = DA_mechanics_upgrade.missions_2.flag } clr_country_flag = DA_mechanics_upgrade.missions_2.flag hidden_effect = { change_variable = { which = DA_mechanics_inno_points value = 2 } } }
		if = { limit = { has_country_flag = DA_mechanics_upgrade.missions_3.flag } clr_country_flag = DA_mechanics_upgrade.missions_3.flag hidden_effect = { change_variable = { which = DA_mechanics_inno_points value = 3 } } }
		if = { limit = { has_country_flag = DA_mechanics_upgrade.missions_4.flag } clr_country_flag = DA_mechanics_upgrade.missions_4.flag hidden_effect = { change_variable = { which = DA_mechanics_inno_points value = 4 } } }
		if = { limit = { has_country_flag = DA_mechanics_upgrade.drydocks_1.flag } clr_country_flag = DA_mechanics_upgrade.drydocks_1.flag hidden_effect = { change_variable = { which = DA_mechanics_inno_points value = 1 } } }
		if = { limit = { has_country_flag = DA_mechanics_upgrade.drydocks_2.flag } clr_country_flag = DA_mechanics_upgrade.drydocks_2.flag hidden_effect = { change_variable = { which = DA_mechanics_inno_points value = 2 } } }
		if = { limit = { has_country_flag = DA_mechanics_upgrade.drydocks_3.flag } clr_country_flag = DA_mechanics_upgrade.drydocks_3.flag hidden_effect = { change_variable = { which = DA_mechanics_inno_points value = 3 } } }
		if = { limit = { has_country_flag = DA_mechanics_upgrade.drydocks_4.flag } clr_country_flag = DA_mechanics_upgrade.drydocks_4.flag hidden_effect = { change_variable = { which = DA_mechanics_inno_points value = 4 } } }
		DA_SCH_refresh = yes
	}
}

# Country scope (players, every month): the lines bought, in every owned province. A new building gets its upgrade
# at once (its on_built), a lost one loses it here; the buildings of Anbennar's file and the lines with a trigger
# (a mine, a port) are only taken here. The retired lines first (doc 85).
DA_MEC_monthly = {
	DA_MEC_retire = yes
	if = { limit = { has_country_flag = DA_mechanics_upgrade.appraiser_3.flag } every_owned_province = { DA_MEC_sync_appraiser = yes } }
	if = { limit = { has_country_flag = DA_mechanics_upgrade.artisan_3.flag } every_owned_province = { DA_MEC_sync_artisan = yes } }
	if = { limit = { has_country_flag = DA_mechanics_upgrade.assembler_3.flag } every_owned_province = { DA_MEC_sync_assembler = yes } }
	if = { limit = { has_country_flag = DA_mechanics_upgrade.counting_1.flag } every_owned_province = { DA_MEC_sync_counting = yes } }
	if = { limit = { has_country_flag = DA_mechanics_upgrade.tithes_1.flag } every_owned_province = { DA_MEC_sync_tithes = yes } }
	if = { limit = { has_country_flag = DA_mechanics_upgrade.excise_1.flag } every_owned_province = { DA_MEC_sync_excise = yes } }
